name: Auto-Forged Repair Drones
desc: This vessel has unique micro-forges situated throughout the hull.  These micro-forges consume vast stores of materials to rapidly produce repair drones en masse to rebuild the hull and critical components.  The Ship regenerate %s/%s/%s/%s hull every second in combat, with weapons and engines repaired %s faster.  The automation of repairs reduces crew casualties by %s.
short: Inbuilt micro-forges allow the repair of the ship's hull within combat, increasing engine and weapon repair, and reducing crew causalties

name: Composite Ablative Armor
desc: Thick slabs of modular armor meant to ablate in response to all damage types covers this ship's hull.  Reduces the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculations to %s of its actual value.  This modular plating is far easier to replace outside of combat, resulting in the ship's hull and armor being repaired %s faster out of combat.
short: Reduces effective armor and increases repair speed out of combat.
